name: @treeviz/treeviz-connector
description: Chrome extension that compares an Ancestry or MyHeritage person with a TreeViz tree.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && esbuild src/background.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/background.js && esbuild src/popup.ts --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/popup.js && esbuild src/content/ancestry.ts src/content/myheritage.ts src/content/treeviz.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outdir=dist/content
